response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM station_shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.share AS difference_above_average FROM station_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share ORDER BY difference_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
